title: Survey, reuse and choose what Yoke takes over
when: First project onboarding or explicit adoption of existing work
need: An existing app needs mapping of docs, tests, CI and deployment. Agree on inherited work to adopt versus leave underway; a new project may need scaffolding.
gap: Define the adoption boundary for existing PRs/items, avoid duplicate filing, and preserve accepted strategy. Infrastructure setup now waits until the first work needs it; later adoption scenarios stay with JOURNEYS.
review: Source now teaches a free-form non-empty profile object and reading an existing verification binding by scope before registering it. The broader adoption recipe still awaits proof.
